# Mukul — Frontend Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio of Mukul Bushi Reddy M (Mukul), a Frontend Developer specializing in Angular, TypeScript, React, Flutter, and AI-integrated web products.

Mukul builds responsive, user-centric digital products end-to-end — from concept to production. Focus areas: Angular, TypeScript, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, Firebase, Node.js, and AI integration (Gemini API).
